title: Kilo Print-to-Program Reconcile & Gap-Closure
brief: The kilo (print-to-program) slot queue surfaced 138 units that are not autonomous-loop-buildable: DOMAIN-PIPELINE-MS0 print2prog stages carry spec='pending-generator' (no real spec), FEATURE-GAP-AUDIT-MS0 U-GAP-P2P-* units are advisory_only/must_human_verify (audit findings, not specs), and the priority-queue picker surfaces fabricated MS-TRAIN-DEEP IDs (U-TRAIN-P2P-NN) that do not match the envelope's real IDs (U-MS-TRAIN-DEEP-NN). Meanwhile the print-to-program CAPABILITY is heavily built: 16 *PrintToProgram* engines (~600K LOC), PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.ts is 143.7K, and prism_cam exposes print_to_program / _full / _enhanced / _plan / _validate / _regression_run / auto_print_to_program. The genuine gap is reconciliation between built reality and roadmap state, plus one real functional defect: millDispatcher's 'program' bucket lazy-imports the MillPrintToProgramEngine STUB (returns {ok:false,stub:true}) instead of the real MillingPrintToProgramEngine (81.1K, runFullPipeline). This milestone fixes the functional defect, audits/wires the P2P engine set, fixes the dev-tooling picker bug, and reconciles the silent close-out debt so the kilo queue becomes loop-ready. E2E functional-equivalence validation is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE here — it is owned by the existing PrintToProgramRegressionHarnessEngine.ts + prism_cam:print_to_program_regression_run actions + MS-TRAIN-DEEP U-TRAIN-P2P-04/05.
supersedes_note: Does NOT delete DOMAIN-PIPELINE-MS0 / FEATURE-GAP-AUDIT-MS0 / MS-TRAIN-DEEP. U-KP2P-04 reconciles their status fields advisory-only; envelopes are preserved per feedback_never_delete_only_disable.

existing_engines_cited: PrintToProgramPipelineEngine.ts (143.7K) — master orchestrator, already built; PIPE-MS0 P1-U01 is silent close-out debt
MillingPrintToProgramEngine.ts (81.1K) — real mill engine, entry runFullPipeline(MillingInput):MillingProgramResult @ line 2005, singleton millingPrintToProgramEngine
codebase_audit.no_new_engines: This milestone creates ZERO new engines. All work is wiring, dispatcher reconciliation, dev-tooling fix, and roadmap-status reconciliation. Duplication guard not triggered.

units.title: Rewire millDispatcher program bucket: stub -> real MillingPrintToProgramEngine

Re-point the bucket to the real MillingPrintToProgramEngine (singleton millingPrintToProgramEngine); its sole print-to-program entry method is runFullPipeline (~line 2005). The stub's generate/process names do NOT exist on the real engine.
units.spec: 1. millDispatcher.ts:126 — change `(await import('../../engines/MillPrintToProgramEngine.js')).millPrintToProgramEngine` to `(await import('../../engines/MillingPrintToProgramEngine.js')).millingPrintToProgramEngine`. 2. Line 497 (mill_print_to_program) — set the callOrThrow method list to ['runFullPipeline'] (the real engine's SOLE print-to-program entry; do NOT carry process/generate — those are stub-only names absent from MillingPrintToProgramEngine, and leaving them would mask a wrong-method regression); update the engine-name label arg from 'MillPrintToProgramEngine' to 'MillingPrintToProgramEngine'. 3. Line 509 (mill_generate_gcode) — verify the real engine's gcode method name (read MillingPrintToProgramEngine method list); if runFullPipeline returns gcode within MillingProgramResult, point mill_generate_gcode at runFullPipeline + document the result shape, else use the real method. 4. MillPrintToProgramEngine.ts — DO NOT DELETE (feedback_never_delete_only_disable). Add a `// SUPERSEDED by MillingPrintToProgramEngine (U-KP2P-01 2026-05-22)` header comment above the existing WIRE-EXEMPT line; keep the file so any other lazy importer does not break.

units.title: Fix priority-queue.mjs slot/domain filter — stop peer-slot + ID-drift leakage
units.summary: priority-queue.mjs --pick --slot kilo surfaces units whose envelope slot field is a different slot (e.g. U-DPM0-WIRE-PRINT_OCR is slot:charlie) and fabricated MS-TRAIN-DEEP IDs that do not match the envelope (U-TRAIN-P2P-NN vs U-MS-TRAIN-DEEP-NN). The picker conflates the pipeline STAGE name (PRINT_OCR) with the print2prog DOMAIN. Add a slot-ownership filter: a unit carrying an explicit envelope slot field different from the requested slot is excluded; unassigned-slot and matching-slot units pass through.
units.realized_note: BOTH abort_criteria conditions were hit during investigation and the fix re-scoped accordingly (still within priority-queue.mjs): (1) ROADMAP-CONSOLIDATED.json pending_units carry NO slot field — the per-unit slot lives on the milestone-envelope units[] entry (verified: U-DPM0-WIRE-PRINT_OCR slot:charlie, MILL slot:alpha, LATHE slot:bravo) and is STRIPPED during consolidation. (2) The picker does not fabricate IDs — U-TRAIN-P2P-NN aliases live in ROADMAP-CONSOLIDATED unconsolidated_prose[] while U-MS-TRAIN-DEEP-NN are in pending_units; both are sourced for the same milestone. ROOT CAUSE of both is upstream in consolidate-roadmaps.mjs (it should carry slot through + dedupe prose against envelopes). Fixed at the picker boundary: new pure helpers buildEnvelopeIndex/resolveUnitSlot/isProseAliasOfEnvelope re-resolve each unit's slot from mcp-server/data/milestones/*.json envelopes and drop unconsolidated_prose units whose milestone has a real envelope. pickNextUnit applies both filters. Verified: --pick --slot kilo no longer surfaces U-DPM0-WIRE-PRINT_OCR (charlie) or any U-TRAIN-P2P-NN alias; echo/cam still returns work (R12 fallback intact). 26/26 tests green (18 anti-regression + 8 new). Follow-up flagged: the upstream consolidate-roadmaps.mjs fix would let this picker-side patch become a no-op. Reviewer-B P1 (pickNextUnit can return [] when the pool is fleet-wide-exhausted) is a pre-existing realistically-unreachable property already fail-loud at the CLI — documented in-code, not new code.
units.spec: 1. Read .claude/helpers/priority-queue.mjs domain/slot filter logic (around line 160-230 — domainFilter / cross-domain fallback). 2. Identify where unit records get their slot/domain — trace back to the source (MILESTONE_PROGRESS / envelopes). 3. Add an ownership predicate: keep a unit IF (unit.slot is falsy/unassigned) OR (unit.slot === requestedSlot). A unit with an explicit foreign slot is excluded from that slot's pick. 4. Investigate the ID-drift: the picker's MS-TRAIN-DEEP entries show U-TRAIN-P2P-NN while the envelope has U-MS-TRAIN-DEEP-NN — find where the picker fabricates/aliases IDs and make it use the envelope's real id field. 5. Preserve the existing R12 cross-domain fallback (no in-domain work -> global ranking) — the slot filter must NOT break that path.
acceptance_criteria: node .claude/helpers/priority-queue.mjs --pick --slot kilo returns ZERO units whose envelope slot field is a slot other than kilo (verified: U-DPM0-WIRE-PRINT_OCR slot:charlie no longer appears)
Every unit ID the picker emits matches a real id/unit_id in its source envelope (no fabricated U-TRAIN-P2P-NN aliases)
A new unit test covers: (a) peer-slot unit excluded, (b) unassigned-slot unit passes, (c) matching-slot unit passes, (d) ID-drift detection
Existing priority-queue tests still pass (anti-regression)
The R12 cross-domain global fallback still fires when a slot has zero in-domain work

abort_criteria: The slot field is not actually present on unit records (filter has nothing to key on) — escalate, the fix belongs upstream in build-milestone-progress.mjs
The ID-drift originates in a different file than priority-queue.mjs — re-scope to that file
